mapper.sql: id, pet_id, post_id, application_id, adopter_id, custodian_id, status, abort_reason, completed_at, version, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO adoption_arrangements (pet_id, post_id, application_id, adopter_id, custodian_id, status) VALUES (#{petId}, #{postId}, #{applicationId}, #{adopterId}, #{custodianId}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM adoption_arrangements WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE adoption_arrangements SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = now(), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING_HANDOVER'
UPDATE adoption_arrangements SET status = 'CANCELLED', version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING_HANDOVER'
UPDATE adoption_arrangements SET status = 'ABORTED', abort_reason = #{reason}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING_HANDOVER'
